records.recovery: Inspect this operation and /var/log/apt/term.log and /var/log/dpkg.log. Run dpkg --audit as administrator. After reviewing its output, an administrator may need dpkg --configure -a or apt-get --fix-broken install. These can change packages or services; UDM does not run them automatically. If an interrupted UDM operation left /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d, inspect and remove only the UDM guard after recovery. There is no automatic rollback. Restore the disposable VM snapshot if appropriate.
